citation: Özcan FÖ, et al. Physiol Rep 2026;14:e71200
protocol: 20-m shuttle-run test to exhaustion 45 min after 180 mL Arabica coffee, chicory coffee or the no-coffee reference session (control); HR, BP, lactate, glucose pre-exercise, immediately post-exercise and 5 min into recovery
population: 22 healthy moderately active young men, 18-25 y
note: No-coffee reference session is the clean control; session always first, so order is not randomised for it. Dose is the shuttle-run stage schedule, not a set wattage.
